subject: Data Engineering
title: Data Quality Metrics
description: A quick, practical guide to Data Quality Metrics.

hook.text: If you can't measure data quality, you can't improve it. Metrics make quality visible.

buildup.text: Common metrics: null rate, duplicate rate, freshness lag, schema violation count, and referential integrity.

discovery.text: Track metrics per table, per pipeline, and over time. Trends reveal whether quality is improving or decaying.

twist.text: A single metric can mislead. A table with zero nulls but 50% duplicates looks clean on one dimension.

climax.text: A quality scorecard combining multiple metrics gives a holistic view of each dataset's health.

punchline.text: Measure it to manage it. Track it to trust it.

quiz.question: Why should data quality metrics be tracked over time?
options: Trends reveal whether quality is improving or decaying
